content.text: {"label":"outage","confidence":"high","explanation":"This looks like an outage. Payments calls jumped from 107 at 11:30, close to the forecast of 110, to 212 at 11:45. That is the same time P1 incident INC-20261009-3059 was opened at 11:43: debit cards are being declined online and at the till because the card authorisation gateway is failing. In the last hour, card_declined calls ran at 371 against 54 expected (6.9x normal), which accounts for about 317 of the roughly 403 extra calls; service level has stayed around 41-43% even though 48-56 agents were on the phones against 33-36 planned. The incident is still open, so expect high volume to continue until the gateway is fixed.
